description: Use this when the user asks to rename, reschedule, move, update location, link tasks, change participants, or otherwise edit an existing Familia plan. Do not use to create a new plan. Updates can synchronize copies already imported by invited guests and queue notifications; delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

allDay.description: Whether the replacement schedule is all-day.

endAt.description: ISO datetime for replacement end time; null clears end time.

notes.description: Replacement plan notes; null clears notes.

planItemId.description: Familia plan item id to update.

requiresConfirmation.description: Whether participants should confirm coverage or attendance; null clears the setting.

startAt.description: ISO datetime. When provided, replaces the plan schedule with a one-time schedule.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for startAt/endAt, e.g. Europe/Prague.

name: familia_update_plan
title: Update plan
